build_restapi_rollout_generate: build a FastAPI endpoint that accepts a rollout request and returns generated multimodal output with optional trajectory data
run_rollout_generate: run the POST /rollout/generate endpoint with sampling parameters to generate multimodal outputs via the scheduler client
slice_rollout_trajectory: slice a RolloutTrajectoryData object into per-sample trajectory data for a given batch index and batch size
serialize_rollout_trajectory: serialize RolloutTrajectoryData fields including log probs, debug tensors, denoising env, and DiT trajectory into JSON-serializable dicts
build_rollout_response: build a list of RolloutResponse objects from an OutputBatch, optionally including rollout trajectory data per sample
